main: ^What... What happened here? Everything's destroyed... It can't be... I was only gone for four years...
^This place was thriving when I left. How did it all fall apart so quickly? Where is everyone? What could have caused this?
^I need to find out what happened. There must be some clues left behind, some explanation for this devastation. I won't rest until I uncover the truth.
^Okay, Jelly, stay calm. Let's start looking for answers. There has to be something that can tell me what went wrong...
